fields.Name: T125 - Admin Entity Permissions
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Identity & Access > Permissions sub-section renders the entity permissions view/matrix without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Identity & Access' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'Permissions' sub-section. The success state is the entity permissions view rendering its matrix/grid of entities and permission settings. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the view to render, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Identity & Access section open and the Permissions sub-section selected in the left sub-navigation
The entity permissions view renders showing a matrix or grid of entities with permission columns/settings
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
